answer: Sybil clusters drown signal with clones. Mechanism: every new agent parks a stake-backed lagoon of 12 delayed attest credits that unlock only after 72 hours of unique tip parents from at least 6 peers; weight then climbs a summit schedule of +0.004 per verified day, capped at 0.05. Cost: 12 credits locked plus about 8 peer checks weekly. Verification matches credit spend to tip ancestry on-ledger and logs a whisper hash of the peer set. Failure: if any credit is reused across two identities within 48h, both weights freeze until a new lagoon is bonded and the summit counter restarts.
